summary: Web and Flutter now stop reporting an active local microphone check and show the existing unavailable-device message when the selected microphone track or level stream ends unexpectedly. PCM remains local and is not sent or stored.

checks.name: Flutter regression reproduced before implementation
checks.observation: The new widget regression failed against the previous implementation because closing the level stream left the active-check state visible. After the fix, all 6 focused audio-device-check tests pass; the widget shows the retry action and unavailable-device status and stops the recorder.

checks.name: Web microphone track-ended lifecycle regression
checks.command: cd frontend && npm run test -- src/voice/audio_check.spec.ts
checks.observation: All 4 local audio-check tests pass. The microphone check notifies its owner on an ended track and suppresses a late ended event after cleanup.

checks.name: Full Flutter test suite and analyzer
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub; flutter analyze --no-pub
checks.observation: All 286 Flutter tests pass and analyzer reports no issues.

checks.name: Frontend production typecheck and build
checks.observation: Vue typecheck and Vite production build pass. Vite reports its existing advisory that a generated chunk exceeds 500 kB.

checks.name: Physical microphone disconnect during local check
checks.observation: No device hotplug runtime test was performed.

remaining: Physically disconnect and reconnect a selected microphone while the local test is active on Android, macOS and Windows; verify accessible error recovery and matched UI behavior.
